title: Five EU countries tout Rwanda deportation partnership but no formal deal as key details remain secret
lede: Rwanda is set to host a so-called EU return hub. No formal deal has been announced as technical details still need to be sorted out in negotiations. The hope is to start deporting people next year.

title: EU’s mandate on Russia-Ukraine peace talks takes shape, as Putin escalates war
lede: While Europe crafts its role in the Ukraine peace talks, Vladimir Putin’s renewed offensive raises the cost of every EU decision.

title: Ukraine damages Crimean Bridge, drones likely hit arch (Ukraine Battlefield update, Day 1,726)
lede: Ukrainian drones pound the Crimean Bridge and Russian tanks stall in fog near Dobropillia. In the meantime, commanders on both sides are gambling lives and prestige on offensives that keep collapsing under precision strikes.
